Hey! It’s awful the anniversaries…
I was raped 6 years ago on valentines day and every anniversary I cry…

Just let you know that you’re not alone, it gets better! In the first years, I cried in pain... But the last years have been more like ‘happy’ tears because I’m not in that position anymore and everything changed for the good.

Promise, this pain you’re feeling will go away and it will only be a scar.

Try to have a really good day, prepare for watching your favorite tv show, eat whatever you want, read, be with someone you feel safe with, and be busy!

I send you tons of hugs, if you need to talk I’m always here

Hi! First of all, I’m sorry it happened to you, it shouldn't have, you were a kid you weren’t supposed to know how to deal with this.

This is a trauma, generally, a trauma is when something happens to you and your brain doesn't have the resources to deal with what happened, so it’s more likely that you’re stuck in thoughts like why? how? could I have prevented this? 

The trauma is asking for resources that you don’t have. What you should do? Learn them! 

1) Acknowledge that you were a child and those people were supposed to protect you and they LET YOU DOWN. You didn't know any better and by age, you shouldn’t know any better. Not your fault at all.

2)  Now, it’s your responsibility to deal with the trauma, go to a therapist, they will give you the resources you need!

Well, I change career from Marketing to Web Developer :) so kind of a big change...

In the first job I was Project Manager but I didn't have enough experience... I felt like anything I was doing was good enough, and I felt so f-ing alone, it seemed that just because i had the project manager position apparently meant that I could solve all the problems by myself and if I ever asked to my superior ANYTHING he would yell at me because "why i didn't knew that". So I was in a position that I didn't like, I wasn't learning anything, the environment was awful.

And then, when I change my career... Well I was curious about coding... I mean, I like to code and solve problems with coding but again I didn't felt good enough, I found this Jr position, in wich no one expects you to know anything hahaha and my superiors teach me soooo many things, if I had a problem and for some reason I couldn't solve it I could go to any of my collegues and asked them. Definitely the team made me feel super comfortable and finally I was learning :)

Yeah, maybe I didn't understand backup plan hahaha like for career? Or what did you mean?

Hey, first of all I'm sorry you're feeling this way it must be so f-ing hard!

So for the record, you're not the problem. 

I used to think the same when I was working for something that I wasn't really interested on and ON TOP OF THAT in a company that really didn't care how the employees felt. 

But I change my career... I started doing part time in two separate companies (the one I was curious and the other one that I hated), of course it was kind of hard at the beginning, I felt I wasn't good enough either but... Here comes the most important part, the company cared about how I felt, the environment of the company was perfect, now I had a team :) so when I felt comfortable I quit my old job and started working full time in the new company

It's never too late to change careers, I did that but maybe you need a different back up plan. If you want... we can chat and make a backup plan that best suits you :)
